{"action":"shell","command":"python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='/testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s=open(p).read()
# 1) Key Entities: Entry gains expiry state
old_ent='''- **Entry**: A live mapping of one hashable key to one deep-copied value and a
  set of distinct string tags; occupies exactly one capacity slot; has an LRU
  recency position.
'''
new_ent='''- **Entry**: A live mapping of one hashable key to one deep-copied value and a
  set of distinct string tags; occupies exactly one capacity slot; has an LRU
  recency position; carries an optional absolute expiry (milestone 3, R07/R08)
  that is entry state preserved by resize (FR-019) and replaced on overwrite
  (FR-027).
- **Timer**: The time source for expiry decisions; defaults to the standard
  monotonic clock when the constructor is given `timer=None`; any supplied
  callable is used exclusively for computing and comparing expiries.
'''
assert old_ent in s
s=s.replace(old_ent,new_ent,1)
# 2) Assumptions: add A12, A13 after A11
old_a11='''- **A11**: `invalidate_many` deduplicates the requested tag set for matching
  (duplicates in the request do not change the match set or the returned
count); the returned count is always the number of distinct removed keys.
'''
new_a11=old_a11+'''- **A12**: A "finite nonnegative int/float excluding bool" TTL accepts `int`
  and `float` values `>= 0` that are finite; `bool` is rejected although it is
  an `int` subclass; negative, non-numeric, and non-finite values (infinity,
  NaN) are invalid. The expiry is the absolute instant `timer() + ttl`
  computed once at insertion (or replacement); it is not recomputed on later
  reads.
- **A13**: "Without touching the recency of surviving entries" (R08) means the
  purge removes only expired entries and leaves the relative LRU order of the
  survivors exactly as it was before the purge; a subsequent `get` hit still
  refreshes recency as usual (FR-008).
'''
assert old_a11 in s
s=s.replace(old_a11,new_a11,1)
# 3) Traceability table: add R07/R08 rows before the final row
old_row='''| Conflicting design note | A9 | superseded by R04/R05; MUST NOT be relied upon |
'''
new_row='''| R07 (milestone 3) | FR-022, FR-023, FR-024, FR-025 | timer default, ttl semantics, invalid TTL, boundary |
| R08 (milestone 3) | FR-026, FR-027, FR-028 | purge-before-operation, expiry replacement, live-only counts, back-compat |
| Conflicting design note | A9 | superseded by R04/R05; MUST NOT be relied upon |
'''
assert old_row in s
s=s.replace(old_row,new_row,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok entities+assumptions+traceability')
PYEOF"}
